tools.name: fee_quote
tools.description: fomo's own fee for ONE spot trade (a buy or a sell) of a given USD size, computed from fomo's published schedule (help centre "Trading fees on fomo"). Route: "solana-low" (Solana, lowest-fee route: $0.10 under $5, 2% to $47.50, $0.95 flat to $190, then 0.50%), "solana-other" (Solana, other routes: 0

tools.name: realized_fee
tools.description: What fomo spot traders actually paid in fomo fees as a share of spot volume, measured from DefiLlama's fomo Wallet fee and volume data (fees on all chains divided by volume, same days, closed days only), against the 0.50% sticker rate. Returns the last 30 days, the last 7 days, the last complete mon

tools.name: get_referral_info
tools.description: What a fomo referral code does for the trader (0.50% becomes 0.45%; nothing else changes), when it can be applied, what fomo pays the referrer, and whether JomoBench has a fomo code (today it does not). Pass venue "fomo" (default), another app JomoBench links to, or "all".

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Find JomoBench pages (fees, the bench measurements, guides, explainers, comparisons, data, news) for a question or keyword. Returns titles, one-line summaries and URLs; read the page for its dated short answer.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_site · Private data: fee_quote, realized_fee · Public sink: realized_fee.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_site · Private data: fee_quote, realized_fee · Public sink: realized_fee

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
